title: RV Falkor too 科學研究船
summary: 以Falkor too科研船公開設備背景，設計從海床測繪到ROV影像再到開放資料的教學流程，檢查多系統共用電源與時間基準。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use the public facilities of Falkor too for a learning workflow from seabed mapping through ROV imagery to open data, checking shared power and time references. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 區分改裝科研設備與船體質量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Separate research-conversion equipment and hull mass: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 區分改裝科研設備與船體質量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Separate research-conversion equipment and hull mass and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 區分改裝科研設備與船體質量：靜浮平衡時船舶總質量等於排開水的質量；載重、設備、燃料和船體質量應分欄。 本步以「船舶排水質量帳」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Separate research-conversion equipment and hull mass: At static flotation, vessel mass equals displaced-water mass; payload, equipment, fuel and hull belong in separate ledger columns. Use Vessel displacement mass ledger to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是RV Falkor too 科學研究船實際規格：ρ=1025 kg/m³，排水體積V=530 m³。式 m=ρV，基準結果 543.25 t。條件：僅靜水質量平衡；不等於總噸位，也未判定完整穩度。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of RV Falkor too research vessel: ρ=1025 kg/m³, displacement volume V=530 m³. Formula m=ρV gives 543.25 t. Conditions: Static mass balance only; this is not gross tonnage and does not establish intact stability.
steps.failure: 把總噸位當質量會混淆容積指標與重量，先檢查資料欄位定義。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Treating gross tonnage as mass confuses a volume-based index with weight; inspect field definitions first. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 以四欄裝載表加總後與排水質量比對，標出尚未計入的人員、淡水與備品。 本案例另須檢查「區分改裝科研設備與船體質量」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Sum a four-column loading table and compare with displacement mass; flag omitted people, freshwater and spares. Also check that Separate research-conversion equipment and hull mass and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：區分改裝科研設備與船體質量。在測繪控制室、ROV畫面與科學資料管理台完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加排水體積10%，重算可平衡的質量，不推定可額外載客。 算式區的基準值為543.25，改變後為597.575 t。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Separate research-conversion equipment and hull mass. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Mapping control room, ROV imagery and science-data desk. Increase displacement volume alone by 10% and recalculate equilibrium mass without inferring additional passenger capacity. Baseline 543.25 changes to 597.575 t. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「RV Falkor too 科學研究船」的「區分改裝科研設備與船體質量：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海洋調查：回波裡的線索」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Separate research-conversion equipment and hull mass: Mechanism and observation” in “RV Falkor too research vessel”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Ocean Survey: Clues in the Echoes” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.objective: 辨識 建立測繪和ROV調查時間窗 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Create mapping and ROV survey windows and its observable causal relationships.

steps.instructionEn: Create mapping and ROV survey windows: Transit time is distance over mean ground speed; science stations, waiting, turns and weather allowance are separate. Use Transit time and station scheduling to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是RV Falkor too 科學研究船實際規格：距離D=63.6 km、平均對地速度12 km/h。式 t=D/v，基準結果 5.3 h。條件：單段定平均速度，不提供實際航海路線或避碰建議。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of RV Falkor too research vessel: Distance D=63.6 km, mean ground speed 12 km/h. Formula t=D/v gives 5.3 h. Conditions: Single leg at constant mean speed; no actual navigation route or collision-avoidance advice.
steps.failure: 用最大航速規劃所有航段會低估任務時間；應使用具來源的平均情境。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Planning every leg at maximum speed understates mission time; use a documented mean scenario. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 將移航與測站工作畫成甘特時間條，避免把工作時間又計入航段平均速度。 本案例另須檢查「建立測繪和ROV調查時間窗」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：建立測繪和ROV調查時間窗。在測繪控制室、ROV畫面與科學資料管理台完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加距離10%，保持平均速度，重算移航時間並保留工作時段。 算式區的基準值為5.3，改變後為5.83 h。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Create mapping and ROV survey windows. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Mapping control room, ROV imagery and science-data desk. Increase distance alone by 10%, retain mean speed and preserve station-work intervals. Baseline 5.3 changes to 5.83 h. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.
